CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 36

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

4. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

6. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 32
   C. 8
   D. 64

7. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

8. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 33

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 17
   C. 7
   D. 23

11. Solve for x: x + 7 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 13

12. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 1
   D. 13

13. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 1

14. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 26

15. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 40
   C. 3
   D. 13

16. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 34
   B. 17
   C. 22
   D. 66

18. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

19. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 21
   C. 30
   D. 42

21. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

22. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

23. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 56
   C. 1
   D. 57

24. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
